Create auditor login
Read-only access to reports and the ledger for this jail. Ends automatically on the date you set. Prodigy Support can also create these.
Every report they run and every page they open is logged under their name.

What each role can do

Detention OfficerFind and create inmates, deposits, bill inmates, same-day fixes, print receipts.
Commissary ManagerEverything an officer can, plus drawer counts, bank deposits, releases, refunds, reconciliation, approvals of officer fixes.
Jail AdministratorEverything a manager can, plus facility settings, inmate rules, users, auditor logins, and the approvals you turned on.
AuditorRead-only reports and ledger for a set period.
Roles are fixed sets. If a jail needs a mix (for example, an officer who also closes the drawer), give that person the Manager role rather than a custom one.
